evaluation.market_summary: Extremely high demand exists for agentic AI skills in enterprise environments as organizations shift from reactive AI to autonomous systems integrated with existing CRM, ERP, and cloud infrastructure. The market shows rapid acceleration post-2024 with major players launching comprehensive platforms.
evaluation.recommendation: Pursue this as educational content focusing on practical skill development and integration challenges with legacy systems. Position as bridging the gap between enterprise needs and technical implementation rather than competing directly with platforms.
risks: Market saturation with major cloud providers and established AI platforms already addressing core needs
Rapid pace of change in agentic AI could make specific technical content obsolete quickly
